description:
Kamflix Club – Earth Information Jukebox Team

We are Kamflix Club, a youth-led STEM, robotics, and coding club! We hope to combine NASA's Earth observation data with coding, interactive visualization, and creative storytelling to make scientific information more engaging, accessible, and meaningful to people of all ages.
summary:
Project Goal
To develop an interactive, inclusive 3D educational game that connects NASA Earth observation
data with the migration journey of Pacific salmon, helping children and youth understand how
climate, water systems, and biodiversity are interconnected.
details:
Little Salmon Run is a youth-led educational innovation project developed by Kamflix Club

for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge.

Our project combines NASA Earth Information Center visualizations, real-time data sonification,

and a browser-based 3D salmon migration adventure.

Students will explore a virtual river ecosystem where environmental conditions are informed by

NASA Earth observation data. Through interactive missions, they will discover how precipitation,

temperature, and habitat conditions can influence salmon and the ecosystems that depend on

them.

The game's central innovation is its integration of scientific data and interactive storytelling.

Rather than simply reading environmental statistics, students will experience changes through

synchronized visualizations, sounds, and gameplay.

The platform will also provide standard and sensory-friendly learning modes, enabling students

with different sensory preferences and accessibility needs to participate in Earth science

activities.
